text:
maya: Heads-up — PR #5682 blocked on staging smoke. Failing consistently on Windows shard after rebase. CI shows 3 failures in a row. @raj can you take a look? ci-bot ran a targeted rerun already.

raj: on it. link to job: https://buildkite.com/redwood/builds/58712 — I'll grep the logs now.

ci-bot: [auto] Job rerun initiated for build 58712 by @maya. Status: queued.

maya: pasting the failing trace here for quick eyes:
```
AssertionError: SnapshotMismatch
Expected: 'request-id: 12345'
Actual:   'request-id: 67890'
File: tests/staging/smoke_test.py:47
  self.assertEqual(expected, got)
```

lucy: that one looked flaky yesterday too. Could be kv cache warmup + timing. @taylor did your PR touch any eviction or warmup?

taylor: only a tiny backoff tweak in request retry, nothing touching kv or snapshot code. I'll try to repro locally with the same seed.

raj: did a targeted rerun on shard-3 and shard-7 — shard-7 passed, shard-3 failed with same mismatch. Looks nondeterministic across shards. Might be infra timing.

maya: prefer we rerun once more to confirm. If it still fails, let's coordinate a snapshot update instead of forcing merge. Pinging @lucy for potential quick review of snapshot change.

lucy: will take a look after the rerun. If it's just ordering/timestamp noise, I can approve a snapshot update with a note in PR.

sam: FYI I've seen flakiness spike right after yesterday's infra deploy (storage/gc scheduling); filing an issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1423

ci-bot: [auto] Rerun completed: shard-3 FAILED, shard-7 PASSED, overall: unstable.

maya: ok, holding merge and marking PR as blocked in the description. @eng-oncall any telemetry that suggests the infra change caused nondet?

oncall: seeing elevated disk IO and increased tail latency in staging during the failing runs. Reverting the infra change now; will monitor for the next 30m.

maya: thanks — I'll wait for oncall signoff. If revert fixes it, we'll un-block and merge. If not, we will update snapshots and add a test note describing the timing sensitivity. :thumbsup:
